name: wolf-defends-owner
comment: WP-4.6. EntityPlayer.alertWolves (EntityPlayer.java:402-437) with a tamed wolf, on an open stone floor (x -8..23, z -12..20): the player (id 0) at (7.5, 61, -2.5), a wolf (id 1) at (7.5, 61, 2.5), pigs at (3.5, 61, 6.5) (id 2) (10.5, 61, 6.5) (id 3) and (9.5, 61, -8.5) (id 4). t=4, 13, 22 interact with 5 bones: the third taming roll (rand.nextInt(3), EntityWolf.java:336) succeeds with seed 123: tamed, sitting, health 20, owner "Player". t=30 the player punches pig 2 (attack op, player branch: attackTargetEntityWithCurrentItem, alertWolves(pig, true)): the only tamed wolf is sitting, so it is skipped. t=40 pig 3 hits the player for 1 (attack op, direct: EntityPlayer.attackEntityFrom, alertWolves(pig, false)): the player's sitting wolf stands up (setWolfSitting(false)) and targets pig 3 (EntityCreature.setTarget), chases and bites it (EntityWolf.attackEntity, 4 for a tamed wolf). t=160 the wolf itself hits the player for 1: the player's own tamed wolf, so alertWolves returns at once (:404-409). t=170 the player punches pig 4: the wolf, standing with no target, targets pig 4 and hunts it. Before WP-4.6 every wolf counted as untamed and none of the wolf's reactions happened. rng_state and entity_state every tick, player_state every 10 ticks.
